title: Peppermint Bark Brownies
changes_from_base: Unsweetened-chocolate batter with a white chocolate peppermint bark top.
summary: Fudgy chocolate brownies topped with peppermint white chocolate and crushed candy canes.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Melt the butter and unsweetened chocolate in a small pan over low heat, stirring, then take it off the heat and stir in the sugar. Beat in the eggs one at a time and stir in the flour and salt.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in the tin and bake about 25 min, until the top is dry but the centre is still fudgy; a cocktail stick should come out with moist crumbs. Cool completely.

steps.title: Bark
steps.text: Melt the white chocolate gently, stir in the peppermint flavouring and spread it over the cold brownie. Scatter the crushed candy canes over at once.

steps.title: Set
steps.text: Leave about 1 h until the white chocolate sets, then cut into 16 with a hot knife.

tips: Peppermint flavouring is strong, so add it a drop at a time.
Crush the candy canes in a bag with a rolling pin.
Add the candy straight away, before the chocolate sets.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep in an airtight box in a cool place for up to 4 days; the candy softens in the fridge.
